lines.en: label day214:
scene makotoistired1
It’s another normal day in class.
lines.zh: 课堂上又是平凡的一天。

lines.en: Well, normal apart from the fact that Makoto is sleeping, Maya and Chika are absent, Molly and Tsuneyo disappeared out of nowhere, and Yumi is skipping.
lines.zh: 之所以说「平凡」，是因为除了 Makoto 在睡觉、Maya 和 Chika 缺席、Molly 和 Tsuneyo 不知从哪儿冒出来又消失、Yumi 在逃课之外，一切照旧。

lines.en: Actually, that last part is normal. But Maya is typically here and Chika’s stopped skipping altogether ever since I “gave up” on teaching.
lines.zh: 其实最后那点倒是挺正常的。不过 Maya 平时都会在，而 Chika 自从我「放弃」教书之后，就再也不逃课了。

lines.en: It’s crazy how not assigning any[school]work can motivate students as much as this.
lines.zh: 一点[school]作业都不布置，居然能把学生激励到这种程度，真是疯了。

lines.en: More teachers should give up on teaching and just let [teenager]s be [teenager]s.
lines.zh: 应该有更多老师放弃教书，就让 [teenager] 当 [teenager] 好了。

lines.en: I’m sure all these days of idle chit-chat and napping in class will prepare them for the future better than any chemistry or math lesson would.
lines.zh: 我敢说，这些天里无所事事的闲聊和课堂上的打盹，比任何化学课、数学课都更能让她们为未来做好准备。

lines.en: scene makotoistired2
: Sensei! Can you tell Ayane to stop referring to this weird watermelon thingy as Maya?
lines.zh: : Sensei！您能不能让 Ayane 别管这个奇怪的西瓜玩意儿叫 Maya？

lines.en: : It’s not a “Weird watermelon thingy,” Ami. This is our good friend, Maya Makinami.
lines.zh: : 这可不是什么「奇怪的西瓜玩意儿」，Ami。这是我们的好朋友，Maya Makinami。

lines.en: : Sensei, you didn’t mark Maya down as absent did you? I know it might be confusing that she switched seats, but I can assure you this is her.
lines.zh: : Sensei，您该不会把 Maya 记成缺席了吧？我知道她换了座位可能有点让人困惑，但我向您保证，这就是她。

lines.en: menu:
Good morning, Maya
lines.zh: 早上好，Maya

lines.en: : Good morning, Maya. You look lovely today.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Maya。你今天看上去真美。

lines.en: The watermelon remains silent as it is a watermelon.
lines.zh: 西瓜保持沉默，因为它本来就是个西瓜。

lines.en: And, in other news, I have suddenly stooped to Ayane’s level and thrown out any shred of humanity still left circulating throughout my body.
lines.zh: 另外插播一条新闻：我突然堕落到了 Ayane 的水平，把身体里残存的最后一丝人性也扔了个干净。

lines.en: scene makotoistired3
: Am I the only normal person still left in this world?!
lines.zh: : 这世界上就只剩我一个正常人了吗？！

lines.en: : Oh no. It appears we’ve made Ami upset.
lines.zh: : 哦不好。看来我们把 Ami 惹生气了。

lines.en: : Sensei, do you think it might be good for her to spend some time alone in the nearest psychiatric hospital until she gets her thoughts back in place?
lines.zh: : Sensei，您觉不觉得让她到最近的精神病院里独自待一阵子，等她把思绪理顺了再出来，会好一点？

lines.en: : I volunteer to move in and cook for you until she recovers. Which is hopefully not for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 我自愿搬去给您做饭，直到她康复为止。希望她最好别太快好起来。

lines.en: : Preferably until after you give me at least one-
lines.zh: : 最好是等到您至少给我一个——

lines.en: scene makotoistired4
: Say “child” and I will end you.
lines.zh: : 你敢说「孩子」两个字，我就把你了结了。

lines.en: : Is “hug” acceptable instead or is that still too needy?
lines.zh: : 那换成「拥抱」行吗，还是说这样也太黏人了？

lines.en: : You can have a handshake and that’s it.
lines.zh: : 你最多只能握个手，没别的。

lines.en: Ayane pls
lines.zh: Ayane 拜托了

lines.en: : Ayane, I can’t believe I have to tell you this, but that is not Maya.
lines.zh: : Ayane，我真不敢相信自己得跟你讲这个，但那不是 Maya。

lines.en: : It is a watermelon.
lines.zh: : 那是个西瓜。

lines.en: scene makotoistired5
: No, no. You’ve got it all wrong. This is just Maya’s true form.
lines.zh: : 不不不。您完全搞错了。这只是 Maya 的真正形态。

lines.en: : You’ve seen how much she loves watermelons.
lines.zh: : 您也看到了她有多爱西瓜。

lines.en: : Maybe her dreams finally came true and she just...became one! You can’t rule that out!
lines.zh: : 说不定她的梦想终于成真了，然后就……变成了一个西瓜！这种可能性您可不能排除！

lines.en: : As strange as that girl is, I think her dreams are a little different than that...
lines.zh: : 那丫头再怎么古怪，我觉得她的梦想也不至于这样吧……

lines.en: : Where is Maya anyway?
lines.zh: : 话说 Maya 到底去哪儿了？

lines.en: scene makotoistired6
: Right he-
lines.zh: : 就在那——

lines.en: : She was feeling really tired today so she decided to stay in the dorm.
lines.zh: : 她今天特别累，所以决定待在宿舍里。

lines.en: : I tried tickling her to get her out of the bed but she doesn’t have a tickle-reflex so I was kind of just weirdly rubbing her belly for a minute or two.
lines.zh: : 我试着挠她痒痒把她弄下床，可她根本没有怕痒反射，结果我就莫名其妙地揉了她肚子一两分钟。

lines.en: : I’m sure it will be really awkward for both of us to look back on.
lines.zh: : 我敢说我们将来回想起来，一定会尴尬得要命。

lines.en: : Do you have a tickle-reflex, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei 您怕痒吗？

lines.en: : Can I come over there and find out?
lines.zh: : 我能过去亲自验证一下吗？

lines.en: : Or would you rather come into the bathroom with me so I can take your clothes off and find out without several layers between my skin and yours?
lines.zh: : 还是说您更愿意跟我进洗手间，让我把您的衣服脱掉，这样我的皮肤和您的之间就不用隔着好几层布了？

lines.en: scene makotoistired7
: Sorry to burst your bubble, but I can answer that question without the need for you to inconvenience Sensei at all.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打扰你的美梦了，不过这个问题我就能回答，完全不用你去麻烦 Sensei。

lines.en: : Of course he has a tickle-reflex. I have firsthand experience with it.
lines.zh: : 他当然怕痒。我可是有第一手经验的。

lines.en: : I tickle him all the time.
lines.zh: : 我经常挠他痒痒。

lines.en: : You have not tickled me once.
lines.zh: : 你一次都没挠过我。

lines.en: At least that I can remember.
lines.zh: 至少我记得是没有。

lines.en: : Does he now? I’d still like to experience this on my own to confirm.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我还是想自己亲身体验一下，好确认确认。

lines.en: : Maybe the two of us could do it together since I’m apparently not allowed to lure him into a bathroom by myself.
lines.zh: : 既然显然不许我一个人把老师骗进洗手间，那我们俩一起上怎么样？

lines.en: : No thanks. You can go tickle Maya.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不用。你去挠 Maya 吧。

lines.en: : In fact, I encourage you to do that so she doesn’t think I’m the weird one anymore.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我还挺鼓励你去的，这样她就不会觉得我是那个奇怪的人了。

lines.en: : If you do it for like two minutes you’ll probably break my record.
lines.zh: : 你要是能坚持个两分钟左右，大概就能破我的纪录了。

lines.en: : As long as she wears her Halloween costume, I support this.
lines.zh: : 只要她穿上那套万圣节服装，我举双手赞成。

lines.en: Is it a little too narcissistic for me to want to see that?
lines.zh: 我想看这个，是不是有点太自恋了？

lines.en: It’s not, right?
lines.zh: 不算吧，对吧？

lines.en: I’m a totally normal human teacher who just wants to see a [young_girl] dressing up as him be tickled by an equally [young_girl].
lines.zh: 我完全是个正常的人类教师，只是想看一个 [young_girl] 打扮成我的样子，被另一个同样 [young_girl] 的人挠痒痒。

lines.en: This is a normal desire for a male to have.
lines.zh: 对一个男人来说，这是再正常不过的愿望。

lines.en: : Hehehehe...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: I suddenly feel the fingers of a certain Irish girl find their way to my waist and begin to rapidly move back and forth amidst her giggling.
lines.zh: 我突然感觉到某个爱尔兰女孩的手指摸上了我的腰，一边咯咯笑着，一边飞快地来回动起来。

lines.en: : Molly, what are you doing?
lines.zh: : Molly，你在干什么？

lines.en: : Succeeding where others have not, Sir!
lines.zh: : 做到别人做不到的事，长官！

lines.en: : Fall victim to my fingertips, overflowing with the radiant energy of the seventh sun!
lines.zh: : 臣服于我的指尖吧，那其中满溢着第七太阳的璀璨能量！

lines.en: A...second set of fingertips suddenly joins Molly’s near my ribs.
lines.zh: 又……第二双手的指尖突然在我肋骨附近加入了 Molly 的行列。

lines.en: I do not react because I am too stoic and unwavering to have a so-called “tickle reflex.”
lines.zh: 我没有反应，因为我坚毅沉稳、毫不动摇，根本不存在什么所谓的「怕痒反射」。

lines.en: : Fall victim to my fingers as well, bro.
lines.zh: : 也臣服于我的手指吧，bro。

lines.en: : Good morning, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Ah-
scene makotoistired8

I turn around to find both residents of Dorm Room 6, who have just finished attempting to tickle me for some reason, standing up against the chalkboard that I have used maybe twice since I started teaching.
lines.zh: 我转过身，发现 6 号宿舍的两位住户正靠在黑板旁边站着——她们刚刚不知为何尝试挠我痒痒。而那块黑板，自我开始教书以来我大概只用过两次。

lines.en: : How long have you two been there?
lines.zh: : 你俩在那儿多久了？

lines.en: : Since the first bell tolled, of course!
lines.zh: : 当然是从第一声铃响就开始了！

lines.en: : The Kendo Princess jumped into my shroud of concealment and we were able to sneak behind you without so much a hint of being detected.
lines.zh: : 剑道公主躲进了我的隐匿斗篷，我们这才得以绕到您背后，一丝一毫都没有被发现。

lines.en: : It was my first time becoming invisible. I felt very excited.
lines.zh: : 那是我第一次隐身。我觉得非常兴奋。

lines.en: : Congratulations, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene makotoistired9
: Ah-
: Anyway, what do the two of you want?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你俩到底想干嘛？

lines.en: : All we want is your undying attention and enlistment into our ever-growing army.
lines.zh: : 我们只想要您至死不渝的关注，以及让我们加入那支不断壮大的军队。

lines.en: : And perhaps several thousand headpats and a chance to entwine our fingers in-
lines.zh: : 外加几千次摸头，还有一次十指相扣的机会——

lines.en: scene makotoistired10
: Uhh...
: Ts...Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Ts……Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : If this was all you wanted, I could have done it.
lines.zh: : 如果只是这样，我早就做了。

lines.en: : Your hair is surprisingly soft. What type of conditioner do you use?
lines.zh: : 你的头发意外地柔软。你用的是哪种护发素？

lines.en: : We use the same bottle...
lines.zh: : 我们用的是同一瓶……

lines.en: : What were you saying about entwining fingers?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说十指相扣是怎么一回事？

lines.en: : Would you like to hold hands as well?
lines.zh: : 你也想牵手吗？

lines.en: scene makotoistired11
: Uhh...No. I was just joking about that.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。我只是开个玩笑而已。

lines.en: : Your cheeks show your true desires. Come. Join hands with me.
lines.zh: : 你的脸颊暴露了你真正的渴望。来吧。与我牵手。

lines.en: scene makotoistired12
: Get yer’ friggin’ hand off my head! The yuri tag is still a ways off!
lines.zh: : 把你那该死的手从我头上拿开！百合标签还早着呢！

lines.en: : Yuri tag?
lines.zh: : 百合标签？

lines.en: scene makotoistired13
: Uhh...anyway!
lines.zh: : 呃……总之！

lines.en: : We’re...here to tell you that we talked to the principal.
lines.zh: : 我们……是来告诉您，我们去找校长谈过了。

lines.en: : The principal? About what?
lines.zh: : 校长？谈什么？

lines.en: : You know...all that stuff we said at the Halloween party before I got totally hammered and started rantin’ about my dad.
lines.zh: : 就是……万圣节派对上我们说的那些，在我彻底喝断片、开始痛骂我爸之前说的那些。

lines.en: scene makotoistired14
: I believe she is referring to how the two of us started crying when we found out you would not be teaching us again next year.
lines.zh: : 我想她指的是，当我们得知您明年不会再教我们时，我们俩哭出来的事。

lines.en: : Even though you really haven’t taught us this year, either.
lines.zh: : 尽管您今年其实也没教过我们什么。

lines.en: : Yes, I got that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我听明白了。

lines.en: : I didn’t know you two talked to the principal, though. Makoto should have told me about something like that.
lines.zh: : 不过我不知道你们俩去找了校长。这种事 Makoto 本该告诉我的。

lines.en: scene makotoistired15
: Well, we did! And boy do I have some great news to share with you!
lines.zh: : 总之我们去了！而且我有个天大的好消息要告诉您！

lines.en: : Wait, were you really approved to be in my class again next year?
lines.zh: : 等等，你们真的获批明年继续在我班上？

lines.en: Not like it matters if this cycle is just going to repeat again soon anyway.
lines.zh: 反正这个循环很快就要重来一遍，这事其实也无关紧要。

lines.en: But I’m glad these two cared enough to go to the effort of actually doing something about their troubles rather than just sitting back and accepting them.
lines.zh: 但我很高兴她们俩足够在乎，愿意真的为自己的处境去做点什么，而不是坐着逆来顺受。

lines.en: That’s actually kind of admirable- especially for these two misfits.
lines.zh: 说实话这还挺让人敬佩的——尤其是对这两个怪人而言。

lines.en: : Oh, heck no. We weren’t approved at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然没有。我们压根没获批。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well then what’s the good news?
lines.zh: : 那好消息是什么？

lines.en: : The good news is that we weren’t not-approved either.
lines.zh: : 好消息是，我们也没有被否决。

lines.en: : So it was basically just a maybe?
lines.zh: : 所以基本上就是个「也许」？

lines.en: : Correct. But maybe doesn’t mean no!
lines.zh: : 没错。但「也许」不等于「不行」！

lines.en: : So if the stars align, there is a chance you have not seen the last of Molly MacCormack, Sir!
lines.zh: : 所以只要星辰连成一线，您就未必已经见到了 Molly MacCormack 的最后一面，长官！

lines.en: : In fact, there is no way you have seen the last of Molly MacCormack! This is still her introductory arc!
lines.zh: : 事实上，您绝不可能已经见过了 Molly MacCormack 的最后一面！这还只是她的登场篇章！

lines.en: scene makotoistired16
: Mine as well. The two of us have not even lost Virginia yet.
lines.zh: : 我也是。我们俩连 Virginia 都还没丢。

lines.en: : I still don’t fully understand what that means, but I know it will be an important obstacle to overcome on the path to womanhood.
lines.zh: : 我到现在也没完全明白那是什么意思，但我知道那会是通往女人之路上必须跨越的重要障碍。

lines.en: : Right-o, Tsuney-o. If you wind up losing Virginia before me, though, I’m throwing down Damnation.
lines.zh: : 说得对，Tsuney-o。不过要是你比我先丢掉 Virginia，我就要扔下「毁灭」了。

lines.en: : That sounds scary.
lines.zh: : 听起来很可怕。

lines.en: : Very scary. It destroys all creatures. They can’t be regenerated either.
lines.zh: : 非常可怕。它会毁灭一切生物。而且它们还无法再生。

lines.en: : I don’t know much about regeneration, but I am almost positive that I am a creature.
lines.zh: : 我不太懂再生是什么，但我几乎可以确定，我是一个生物。

lines.en: : Is Virginia really the term we’re using now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在真的要用 Virginia 这个词了吗？

lines.en: scene makotoistired17
: Oh-ho-ho~ Have you caught on to what Virginia means, Sir?
lines.zh: : 哦呵呵~ 长官，您已经猜到 Virginia 是什么意思了吗？

lines.en: : A typical visual novel protagonist wouldn’t connect all of those dots for at least another twenty hours.
lines.zh: : 换成一般视觉小说的主角，至少还要再过二十个小时才能把这些点都连起来。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think I’ve made it pretty apparent that I’m not exactly “typical” so far.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想到目前为止，我已经很清楚地表现出了自己一点都不「一般」。

lines.en: : That just means there’s more of a chance for me to succeed. Especially without the presence of a childhood-friend heroine.
lines.zh: : 那只是意味着我成功的机会更大了。尤其是在没有青梅竹马女主角在场的情况下。

lines.en: : Molly says my archetype is “The one without a real shot.”
lines.zh: : Molly 说我的角色类型是「毫无胜算的那一个」。

lines.en: : It sounded offensive when I heard it but I don’t know what this “shot” is in regard to anyway, so I should not be upset just yet.
lines.zh: : 听着像是侮辱，可我连这个「胜算」指的是什么都不清楚，所以现在还不该生气。

lines.en: : Good luck, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 祝你好运，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : You definitely do have a shot, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你绝对是有胜算的。

lines.en: scene makotoistired18
: I do?
lines.zh: : 我有吗？

lines.en: : She does?!
lines.zh: : 她有？！

lines.en: : Of course. What kind of protagonist would I be to rule anyone out without giving them a chance?
lines.zh: : 当然。要是不给人机会就把人排除掉，我还算什么主角？

lines.en: : I want to rejoice, but I still don’t understand what the {i}shot{/i} is.
lines.zh: : 我想高兴一下，可我还是不明白那个{i}「胜算」{/i}是什么。

lines.en: scene makotoistired19
: So...it appears that even your closest allies can be your enemies under the right circumstances.
lines.zh: : 那么……看来在合适的条件下，连最亲密的盟友也会变成敌人。

lines.en: : Are we enemies now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在是敌人了吗？

lines.en: : Not yet. But the inevitable turn has begun.
lines.zh: : 还没有。但那不可避免的转变已经开始了。

lines.en: : The clock has started to tick and, whether you like it or not, all shall come tumbling down eventually, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 时钟已经开始滴答作响，不管你愿不愿意，一切终将崩塌，剑道公主。

lines.en: : This battle is only now beginning. And I will not lose to your tanned, womanly charms for I am a proud daughter of the Emerald Isle and GUYS LOVE LOLI CHARACTERS!
lines.zh: : 这场战斗才刚刚开始。我绝不会输给你那晒得黝黑、充满女人味的魅力，因为我是翡翠岛骄傲的女儿，而且男人就是喜欢萝莉角色！

lines.en: : Didn’t you say you were slowly slipping away from the loli tag, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你不是说你正在慢慢摆脱萝莉标签吗？

lines.en: scene makotoistired20
: GAH! DO NOT REMIND ME!
lines.zh: : 呀啊！别提醒我！

lines.en: : I feel like I’ve made a terrible mistake by simply existing.
lines.zh: : 我觉得光是活着这件事本身，就是个可怕的错误。

lines.en: scene makotoistired21
Molly storms off and Tsuneyo immediately follows after her, leaving me staring confusedly at the chalkboard that, once again, I have only used twice.
lines.zh: Molly 气冲冲地走了，Tsuneyo 立刻跟了上去，留我一脸茫然地盯着那块——再说一次——我只用过两次的黑板。

lines.en: : Do not follow me, Kendo Princess! All of my defensive abilities are on cooldown!
lines.zh: : 别跟着我，剑道公主！我所有的防御技能都还在冷却中！

lines.en: : I must follow you. No one else ever talks to me.
lines.zh: : 我必须跟着你。没有别人愿意跟我说话。

lines.en: : That’s because you’re weird and only talk about noodles!
lines.zh: : 那是因为你很奇怪，而且只聊面条！

lines.en: : Loving noodles is not a crime. Do you need me to pat your head again?
lines.zh: : 爱吃面条不是犯罪。需要我再摸摸你的头吗？

lines.en: : Leave me alone!
lines.zh: : 别烦我！

lines.en: Huh...
I hope the fact that two of them talked to the principal doesn’t get me in trouble.
lines.zh: 希望她们俩去找校长这事儿不会给我惹上麻烦。

lines.en: I can’t imagine that conversation went well or...even understandable for that matter.
lines.zh: 我想象不出那段对话能进行得多顺利，或者说……能被听懂到什么程度。

lines.en: Maybe Makoto will know since I’ve never really dealt with anything like that before?
lines.zh: 也许 Makoto 会知道，毕竟我以前从没处理过这种事？

lines.en: scene black
I turn back around and accidentally knock over a stack of papers on my desk, forcing me to bend down and pick them all up before making my way over to Makoto.
lines.zh: 我转回身，不小心碰倒了桌上的一摞文件，只好弯下腰把它们一张张捡起来，然后才走向 Makoto。

lines.en: Typically, she’d jump out of her seat and offer to get them all for me, but she seems rather...
lines.zh: 平时她早就从座位上跳起来，抢着帮我捡了，可她今天看起来有点……

lines.en: scene makotoistired22
Off today...
lines.zh: 不太对劲……

lines.en: : Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto？

lines.en: Makoto remains as still as a statue with her head pressed up against her forearm.
lines.zh: Makoto 一动不动像座雕像，头抵在小臂上。

lines.en: I glance over at Miku to see if she has anything to say about Makoto’s current state, but instead of saying anything or even looking at me, a worried look swallows her face.
lines.zh: 我朝 Miku 瞥了一眼，想看看她对 Makoto 现在这副样子有没有什么要说的，可她一句话也没说，甚至连看都不看我，只是一脸担忧。

lines.en: : Hey. Wake up.
lines.zh: : 嘿。醒醒。

lines.en: I begin to snap my fingers, hoping the noise will wake Makoto from her slumber(?).
lines.zh: 我开始打响指，希望这声音能把 Makoto 从她的沉睡(?)中唤醒。

lines.en: She does not move.
lines.zh: 她一动不动。

lines.en: I guess this is what Maki was talking about the other day when she said Makoto had been acting...out of it?
lines.zh: 我想这就是那天 Maki 说 Makoto 一直……魂不守舍的意思吧？

lines.en: That being said, it doesn’t look like she was able to make any progress if she’s still acting however she’s-
lines.zh: 话虽如此，可她现在还是这副样子，看来并没有任何好转——

lines.en: scene makotoistired23
: Oh, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦，Sensei。

lines.en: : Good morning~
lines.zh: : 早上好~

lines.en: : Good morning...
lines.zh: : 早上好……

lines.en: : What happened to you?
lines.zh: : 你怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : I’m the same...diligent Makoto Miyamura, student council president and class representative.
lines.zh: : 我还是那个……勤勉的 Makoto Miyamura，学生会主席兼班长。

lines.en: : My favorite color is blue and I work in a porn shop.
lines.zh: : 我最喜欢的颜色是蓝色，我在一家色情店打工。

lines.en: : Do you have anything for me to do?
lines.zh: : 您有什么事要我做吗？

lines.en: : I’ll do anything you want.
lines.zh: : 您要我做什么都行。

lines.en: : Yes, actually.
lines.zh: : 有，还真有。

lines.en: : How about you go home for the day?
lines.zh: : 你今天就回家休息怎么样？

lines.en: scene makotoistired24
: And ruin my perfect attendance? Hahaha...Very funny, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 然后毁掉我的全勤记录？哈哈哈……Sensei 您真会开玩笑。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know any better, I’d think you were {s}fucking oblivious{/s} being serious.
lines.zh: : 要不是我了解您，我还真会以为您是认真的很呢，{s}蠢得可以{/s}。

lines.en: : I’ll stay right here.
lines.zh: : 我就待在这儿。

lines.en: : I’m just a liiiiiittle bit tired so I might...doze off every now and then...
lines.zh: : 我只是有一点点累，所以可能会……时不时打个盹儿……

lines.en: The bags under her eyes reveal more than just lack of sleep.
lines.zh: 她眼下的黑眼圈说明的可不只是缺觉。

lines.en: They’re swollen as if she’s been crying for decades straight.
lines.zh: 那双眼肿得像是连着哭了几十年。

lines.en: Like every ounce of water in her body has exited through her eyes and left nothing but the shell of a girl who normally seems so serious.
lines.zh: 仿佛她体内每一滴水分都从眼睛里流了出去，只剩下一个平日里总是那么认真的女孩的空壳。

lines.en: Even her uniform is out of sorts.
lines.zh: 连她的校服都乱七八糟的。

lines.en: : I think the two of us need to talk.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们俩得谈谈。

lines.en: scene makotoistired25
: Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Want me to blow you?
lines.zh: : 要我给您口交吗？

lines.en: : Ma...Makoto! The heck are you sayin’ to Sensei?!
lines.zh: : Ma……Makoto！你他妈在对 Sensei 说什么鬼话？！

lines.en: : What’s goin’ on with you?
lines.zh: : 你这是怎么了？

lines.en: Miku stands up from her desk and whispers as loud as a whisper can be so as to not alert the rest of the class.
lines.zh: Miku 从座位上站起来，用耳语能有多大声就有多大声的音量说着，生怕惊动班上其他人。

lines.en: scene makotoistired26
: Ooooh, Miku’s here!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，Miku 也在啊！

lines.en: : That’s right...I’m in class...
lines.zh: : 对了……我在上课……

lines.en: : I’ve gotta watch what I say or somebody might think I’m a slut.
lines.zh: : 我得注意点措辞，不然别人会以为我是个荡妇。

lines.en: : What the heck are you talkin’ about?...
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底在说什么啊？……

lines.en: : Weren’t you gonna stay home today? Your mom’s been freakin’ out about you and you’re-
lines.zh: : 你今天不是要在家休息吗？你妈都快为你急疯了，而你还——

lines.en: : I’m what?
lines.zh: : 我还什么？

lines.en: : Tell me, Miku.
lines.zh: : 告诉我啊，Miku。

lines.en: : What am I?
lines.zh: : 我是什么？

lines.en: : ...You’re friggin’ scary lookin' right now.
lines.zh: : ……你现在看起来该死的吓人。

lines.en: : And you’re saying stuff to the teacher that you’d never say if you were feelin’ okay.
lines.zh: : 而且你还在对老师说出那种你要是没事的话绝对不会说的话。

lines.en: : What’s wrong? You wanna blow him too?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你也想给他口吗？

lines.en: : Wha-?!
scene makotoistired27
: How does two girls at once sound, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，一次来两个女生怎么样？

lines.en: : Plus, we’re best friends so just think of the...fucking synergy...
lines.zh: : 再说了，我们是最好的朋友，想想那……他妈的协同效应……

lines.en: : That’s it! You’re comin’ with me!
lines.zh: : 够了！你跟我走！

lines.en: : Sensei! I don’t know what the heck is goin’ on with Makoto, but don’t take anythin’ she’s sayin’ today seriously!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我不知道 Makoto 到底怎么了，但她今天说的话您一个字都别当真！

lines.en: : Miku Maruyama’s gettin’ to the bottom of this!
lines.zh: : Miku Maruyama 一定要把这件事查个水落石出！

lines.en: scene black
Miku grabs Makoto by the wrist and begins to drag her out of the class.
lines.zh: Miku 一把抓住 Makoto 的手腕，开始把她往教室外拖。

lines.en: Everyone else has noticed by now.
lines.zh: 这会儿其他人都注意到了。

lines.en: {i}Not{/i} noticing would be impossible.
lines.zh: 想{i}不注意{/i}都难。

lines.en: They all look at me to gauge my reaction once the two of them have left the classroom.
lines.zh: 她俩一离开教室，所有人都看着我，想从我的反应里看出点什么。

lines.en: But, not knowing what else to do, I just go back to leaning against my desk and I guess the rest of the girls decide it’s not anything serious.
lines.zh: 可我不知道还能怎么办，只好重新靠回讲台上，我猜其他女生也就认定这不是什么严重的事了。

lines.en: That or they pretend not to.
lines.zh: 要么，她们就是装作不严重。

lines.en: What’s going on with her?
lines.zh: 她到底怎么了？

lines.en: $ day214 = True
{i}Makoto’s affection is affectionate!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度很有好感！{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
